I came across Thomas Potter while researching UK fastener and fittings stockists — your deep holding of non-preferred items since 1923 really stands out.

Would a short WhatsApp call or a quick catalog be useful if you are ever evaluating alternative metal-hardware sourcing?

Best,
Leo Li
KaiLionCrafts | WhatsApp: +86 131-3800-6564
kailioncrafts.com/oem-odm/
